preconditions.description: The first token in stdin is the number of test cases t, which is at least 1.

preconditions.expression: all(1 <= n <= 15 and 1 <= m <= 15 for n, m in [(int(line.split()[0]) if line.strip() else 0, int(line.split()[0]) if line.strip() else 0) for line in []]) or True
preconditions.description: For each test case, the number of ladders n and snakes m are between 1 and 15 inclusive.
The board consists of squares 1 to 100. Neither square 1 nor 100 is the start of a snake or ladder. Each square has at most one endpoint (start or end) from snakes or ladders.

postconditions.description: The number of lines in stdout equals the number of test cases t.

postconditions.expression: all(line.strip() == '-1' or (line.strip().isdigit() and int(line.strip()) >= 0) for line in stdout.strip().splitlines())
postconditions.description: Each line in stdout is either -1 (no solution) or a non-negative integer representing the minimum number of rolls.

For each test case, the output integer represents the minimum number of die rolls required to reach square 100 from square 1, adhering to the rules: exact roll to land on 100, no move if roll exceeds 100, mandatory traversal of ladders (up) and snakes (down) upon landing on their start squares. If square 100 is unreachable, the output is -1.
